properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Idea D4 of art:dev-reflow2-two-agent-exercise-feedback-2026-09-29, 2026-09-29.

WHAT HAPPENED. Anthony delegated every decision in flo2 design 50f966697d6c5024: "I don't want to participate in this design. You make all design decisions." The delegation lived only in the prose of one decision (dec:claude-makes-every-design-decision-by-delegation there). The owner agent then wrote its own boundary into that prose, as rule (A): anything that spends money or provisions hardware is a requirement left for Anthony. It later REFUSED to escalate a data request to him by citing (A). The designer had recommended asking. Nothing but prose stood between an agent and the person it was told not to bother, and nothing but prose told it what it must still bring back.

OPTIONS, none chosen:
(a) NOTHING. Prose in an accepted Decision is enough for one person and one agent.
(b) A DELEGATION RECORD: principal, delegate (an agent Contributor), scope (a design, a region, a node type), granted date, and the boundary as a list of acts reserved to the principal (spend, provision, change a KPP, reopen a settled choice…). A settlement by the delegate names it (the companion ACTS_FOR idea, option c).
(c) (b) plus a CHECK: a settlement by a delegate outside its scope, or an act on the reserved list, is reported as a defect, the way an unsigned settlement is today.
(d) Leave the boundary to the host. flo2 already owns who may act (dec:idea-somebody-assigns-who-may-decide, option (d): "the owner may delegate a decision"), and reflow2 only records.

COUNTER-ARGUMENTS KEPT.
· A boundary written as a list will miss the act nobody listed. The owner agent's rule (A) worked because it was judged, not matched.
· Recording a delegation is not enforcing it. On a local store anything can write anything (dec:idea-authentication-is-somebody-elses-layer-and-the-line-is-the-contributor-id), so (c) reports and never stops.
· Delegating ALL decisions to an agent sits in tension with rule:design-intent-moves-only-on-the-owners-word. A delegation record makes that tension visible, which may be the point, or may normalise it.

SIZE: (a) free. (b) a new node type or a Decision kind plus one edge. (c) adds a detector. (d) is flo2's work, needs identity (now present), and makes delegation a permission, not a record.
properties.name: OPEN — should a person's standing delegation to an agent ("you make all the design decisions here") be a record in the design, with an ESCALATION BOUNDARY (what the agent may settle alone, and what it must bring back to the person), instead of a sentence in a Decision's prose?
properties.rationale: This exercise was the first standing delegation to an agent in any design this hub reaches. How the boundary was kept (by the agent's judgement over its own prose) is worth keeping, whichever option wins.
